title: Real-time deep CNN assesses Forrest classification of peptic ulcer bleeding
summary: A deep convolutional neural network was trained on 3,868 endoscopic images and reached 91.2% accuracy on 834 internal validation images, with 521 images from four other hospitals used for external validation. On 46 prospectively collected videos it reached 92.0% accuracy in real time and was more accurate and stable than endoscopists in the prospective comparison. The prospective video set is small.
ai_technology: Real-time deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) for endoscopic images
organization: Fujian Medical University; 900th Hospital of PLA; Xiamen University Oriental Hospital

evidence.tested: Accuracy on internal and external image sets and on 46 prospectively collected videos, compared with senior and junior endoscopists.
evidence.unknown: Small prospective video set (n = 46); effect on patient outcomes not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Real-time DCNN classifying Forrest category in endoscopic images and videos.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; affiliations from Europe PMC or Crossref where stated. Publisher full text not accessed.
